title: Sandbox Stanford JAR execution to nltk_data directories

target.summary: _authorize_private_dir appends caller-supplied directories to nltk.data.path when saving or loading a model. This permanently widens the global data search path for the process, allowing subsequent pathsec checks to trust arbitrary user-controlled paths.
notes: definition of the helper function that widens nltk.data.path
faulty statement appending untrusted caller directory to nltk.data.path
call site in save_to_json passing caller-supplied save location
call site in load_from_json passing caller-supplied model location
